source: William Lilly 1647 first edition Wellcome b30338724

groups.topic: Mid-heaven directed to Moon body: mixed business, radix and trade

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Medium-coeli to the body of the Moon
claims.historical_meaning_only: Distinct Moon body/conjunction from benefic/adverse Moon aspects.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: unquiet and busie time
claims.historical_meaning_only: Change and busyness claimed, not a stable outcome.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: afflicted ... in Body and Mind
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historic health/mental distress language, not a medical inference.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: now well now ill ... getting otherwhiles losing
claims.historical_meaning_only: Explicit temporal reversals mean nonmonotonic effects.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if Moon be well and essentially dignified
claims.historical_meaning_only: Interpretation depends on natal essential dignity.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Marriage or strict Friendship with a Woman
claims.historical_meaning_only: Relationship outcome conditional on Moon dignity and life context.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if in the Radix the Moon signified Honour Office Preferment
claims.historical_meaning_only: Office/promotion only if natal Moon already signifies such things.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: inclinacions to travell
claims.historical_meaning_only: Travel inclinations distinguished from travel outcomes.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: shew himselfe in a more publick way
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claim about publicity, not official attainment.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: well dignified ... Mechanicals great Custome and Trade
claims.historical_meaning_only: Mechanics/tradesmen receive a special commercial reading.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: otherwise qualified Preferment Office Dignity
claims.historical_meaning_only: Other status groups receive different office reading.

groups.topic: Moon sextile/trine: material, public and marriage outcomes

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the sextile or trine of Moon
claims.historical_meaning_only: Two favorable Moon aspects, separately named.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: increase of fortune estimation and honour
claims.historical_meaning_only: Economic, reputation, and status change bundled but distinct.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: from the people more then usuall
claims.historical_meaning_only: Claim source of esteem from common people.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: large gifts and donations from some noble Lady
claims.historical_meaning_only: Specific claimed patron class and economic mechanism.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: prospers in Offices Commands and employments
claims.historical_meaning_only: Occupational advancement claimed.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: shall marry some woman ... rich or poore
claims.historical_meaning_only: Marriage partner status tied to natal context.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: according to her well or ill fortification in the Radix
claims.historical_meaning_only: Natal Moon condition modifies alleged marriage outcome.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: journey beyond Sea
claims.historical_meaning_only: Overseas travel as separate target.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: publique commands in the Common-wealth
claims.historical_meaning_only: Public responsibilities conditional on birth/capacity.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: as he by birth or place is capable of
claims.historical_meaning_only: Rank/capacity limitation is explicit.

groups.topic: Moon square/opposition: class-linked disputes and source duration modifiers

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the square or opposition of Moon
claims.historical_meaning_only: Adverse lunar aspects independently described.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: disesteeme of the Commonalty
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged public rejection.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: contentions on the behalfe of Women
claims.historical_meaning_only: Gendered historical accusation, not modern factual causality.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: losse of honour estate and dignity
claims.historical_meaning_only: Office/status and wealth losses kept distinct.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: prodigall and vaine expence
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source alleges excessive expenses.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Death or great danger either unto his Mother ... Wife
claims.historical_meaning_only: High-stakes family health/death rhetoric; never forecast.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mother (if living) or Wife (if married)
claims.historical_meaning_only: Parent/spouse claims explicitly depend on their status.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: if not ... breach betwixt him and his Mistris or friend
claims.historical_meaning_only: Unmarried alternative is social breach, not spouse mortality.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: sentence of some eminent Magistrate Judge
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source alleges adverse official judgments.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: quality of the Signe ... durability
claims.historical_meaning_only: Sign quality purports to modify duration of effects, not immediate outcome.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: strength of the Promittor in the Radix
claims.historical_meaning_only: Natal strength modifies alleged magnitude.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Moon in ... Revolution or return of Sun
claims.historical_meaning_only: Solar-return Moon is named as modifier; method not calculated/validated.

groups.topic: Mid-heaven to cusp of eleventh house: differentiated friendships

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Medium-coeli to the eleventh house
claims.historical_meaning_only: Cusp destination is a separate nonplanetary directed target.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: new friends and they not obscure
claims.historical_meaning_only: Alleged acquisition of relatively notable friends.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Joviall Condition ... Jupiter behold ... cusp
claims.historical_meaning_only: Jupiter aspect/placement conditions specify social character of friends.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Veneriall Friends if Venus doe the same
claims.historical_meaning_only: Venus condition specifies another friend type.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Noblemen Kings and Princes if Sun illustrate
claims.historical_meaning_only: Sun placement/aspect has its own elite-friend association.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: additament of Friendship ... good thereby
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source asserts benefit through friendships, not merely presence.

groups.topic: Mid-heaven to twelfth house and horoscope, before CLXI seam

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Medium-coeli to the twelfth house
claims.historical_meaning_only: Separate twelfth-house cusp case begins printed 676.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: beware of secret Enemies
claims.historical_meaning_only: Historical narrative about covert opposition; not personal danger determination.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Imprisonment Banishment
claims.historical_meaning_only: High-stakes legal threats, historically alleged only.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: losse by or from Four-footed Beasts ... Horses Oxen
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source adds material losses attributed to quadrupeds, continuing printed 677.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: mid-heaven is rarely directed to the horoscope
claims.historical_meaning_only: Source explicitly states rarity of midheaven-to-ascendant direction.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Honours Praise and high Estimation
claims.historical_meaning_only: The rare horoscope direction is described favorably; not a twelfth-house threat.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CLXI The Midheaven Directed to FIXED STARRES
claims.historical_meaning_only: Distinct printed CLXI starts after dividing rule, midway printed 677; excluded from CLX.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: To the Goats in 16.33 Aries; heart of Scorpion ...
claims.historical_meaning_only: Next chapter's fixed-star subsection is navigation only, not to be counted as CLX.

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CLXII The Sunne directed to PROMITTORS
claims.historical_meaning_only: Separate subsequent solar chapter starts PDF713, not within this CLX extraction.
